description: API layer: create POST /runs unified endpoint, delete inline simulation from orchestrator.py/audit.py/agent_config.py, wire settlement approve to HumanApprovalSignal via run_id, replace APScheduler with Temporal Schedules, merge DB+Temporal for GET /runs/{id}. Depends on FEAT-001 (RunInput, migration).
steps: Create api/src/routes/runs.py. Import: APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query; CurrentUser; require_permission; TenantCtx, get_tenant_ctx; temporal_service; RunInput from synthetiq_shared.models; WorkflowRun from synthetiq_shared.models; get_db_session from synthetiq_shared.database; select from sqlalchemy. Router prefix='/runs', tags=['Workflow Runs']. POST /runs: validate body as RunInput, assert_same_org(user['org_id'], run_input.org_id) OR set run_input.org_id from user token if blank, write WorkflowRun(run_id=..., workflow_type='master_e2e_compliance', org_id=run_input.org_id, status='RUNNING', input_params=run_input.model_dump(), triggered_by=user['email']), call temporal_service.start_workflow('MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow', workflow_id=f'wf-{run_id}', args=[run_input.model_dump()], task_queue='synthetiq-main'), update run.temporal_workflow_id and run.temporal_run_id, return {run_id, temporal_workflow_id, temporal_ui_url, status='RUNNING'}. GET /runs: query WorkflowRun filtered by org_id, return typed list. GET /runs/{run_id}: fetch from DB, call temporal_service.get_workflow_description(r.temporal_workflow_id) swallowing exceptions, merge temporal_status into response. DELETE /runs/{run_id}: set status='CANCELLED', attempt temporal handle.cancel().

Register runs_router in api/src/routes/__init__.py: add 'from .runs import router as runs_router' and add 'runs_router' to __all__. In api/src/main.py: add 'from src.routes import runs_router' alongside other imports, add 'app.include_router(runs_router, prefix=API_V1_STR)' after the existing routers. Leave orchestrator_router registered (it stays for 410 compatibility).

In api/src/routes/orchestrator.py, replace the entire execute_e2e_compliance_run function body with: raise HTTPException(status_code=410, detail='Endpoint moved. Use POST /api/v1/runs'). Remove all imports that are now unused: httpx, time (if only used in the function), push_event, constants (MCP_URL, MOCKS_URL, SIMULATOR_URL), get_runtime_config. Keep the GET /runs and GET /runs/{run_id} and GET /runs/{run_id}/steps handlers intact — they are thin DB reads and remain valid. Remove hardcoded literals: clearing_price=7.80, statutory_ceiling=12.0, gross_liability_tons=volume_tons*4.5, historic_debt_tons=volume_tons*1.2, awarded_recycler='RECYC-DELHI-01', plant_id='PLANT-OKHLA-2', simulate_spoof default, DISPATCH_FALLBACK (in temporal_service.py change 'DISPATCH_FALLBACK' string → 'TEMPORAL_UNAVAILABLE').

In api/src/routes/audit.py, replace trigger_fraud_audit function body: remove all inline physics (kw, pf, torque, sec_constants, delta_mass, flags, seed, confidence, verdict computation). New body: validate recycler_id = payload.get('recycler_id') or raise HTTPException(400, 'recycler_id required'); plant_id = payload.get('plant_id') or raise HTTPException(400, 'plant_id required'); category = payload.get('category', 'cat_i_rigid'); volume_tons = float(payload.get('volume_tons', 250.0)); simulate_spoof = bool(payload.get('simulate_spoof', False)); audit_id = f'AUD-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}'; dispatch to temporal QuadCoreAuditWorkflow; return {audit_id, temporal_workflow_id, status='RUNNING'}. Remove 'RECYC-DELHI-01' and 'PLANT-OKHLA-2' defaults from trigger_fraud_audit. Keep GET /audit/scada/live, GET /audit/verdicts, GET /audit/verdict/{id}, HITL endpoints, and PDF endpoints unchanged.

In api/src/routes/settlement.py, update approve_audit_and_settle: accept run_id in payload (required alongside audit_id). Query WorkflowRun from DB by run_id to get temporal_workflow_id (raise 404 if not found). Send HumanApprovalSignal via temporal_service.signal_workflow(workflow_id=temporal_workflow_id, signal_name='resolve_audit_exception', signal_args=[{'approved': action=='APPROVE', 'notes': payload.get('notes',''), 'auditor_id': user['email'], 'reason_code': 'SETTLEMENT_APPROVAL'}]). Update WorkflowRun.hitl_required=False on APPROVE. Remove the fallback workflow_id=f'wf4-settlement-{audit_id}' pattern. Keep all other settlement endpoints unchanged.

In api/src/routes/agent_config.py, treasury branch: replace hardcoded '12.0' default for statutory_base_rate_inr with import of STATUTORY_CEILING_INR_PER_KG from synthetiq_shared.constants: 'from synthetiq_shared.constants import STATUTORY_CEILING_INR_PER_KG' then use 'float(agent_cfg.parameters.get("statutory_base_rate_inr", STATUTORY_CEILING_INR_PER_KG))'. In packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/constants/__init__.py, add: 'STATUTORY_CEILING_INR_PER_KG: float = 12.0' and 'STATUTORY_FLOOR_PCT: float = 0.30' (documents the 30% corridor floor already in constants as COMPENSATION_CORRIDOR_MIN_PCT).

Replace APScheduler with Temporal Schedules: (a) In api/src/routes/schedules.py, rewrite create_schedule endpoint to call await temporal_service.get_client() then client.create_schedule(id=schedule_id, schedule=Schedule(action=ScheduleActionStartWorkflow('MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow', run_input.model_dump(), task_queue='synthetiq-main'), spec=ScheduleSpec(cron_expressions=[CronSequence(expression=cron_expr)]))); DELETE endpoint calls (await client.get_schedule_handle(schedule_id)).delete(); GET list calls client.list_schedules(). (b) In api/src/services/scheduler_service.py, replace entire SchedulerService class body with a TemporalScheduleService thin wrapper that delegates to temporalio.client.Client (no apscheduler import). Keep the same public interface (add_schedule, remove_schedule, list_schedules) so callers don't break. (c) In api/src/main.py lifespan, remove the entire APScheduler startup block (scheduler.start(), scheduler.add_schedule(org_id='ORG-DEV-001', ...)), remove the shutdown block, remove the get_scheduler_service import from startup. Keep the Firebase and DB init blocks.
